card.text: Explore Methone with Cassini imagery on its measured ellipsoid.

introduction.text: Methone is a tiny, egg-shaped moon between Mimas and Enceladus. Cassini found an exceptionally smooth surface with a darker oval on its leading side.

normal.title: ISS clear-filter image
normal.summary: The darker oval is visible at about 27 m per source pixel. Gaps are marked; tiny isolated spots may be detector noise.
